description: This file contains unit tests for the MainThread class in the Rialto server media module, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests creation, registration, task enqueuing, and client unregistration functionalities of MainThread.

classes.name: DummyMock
classes.description: A mock class with a single method mockMethod used for testing MainThread task execution.

classes.name: MainThreadTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing MainThread functionalities, including client registration, task enqueuing, and unregistration.

methods.name: enqueueTaskAndWaitOnDummyMock
methods.description: Enqueues a task that calls dummyMock->mockMethod() and waits for its completion.

methods.name: enqueueTaskOnDummyMock
methods.description: Enqueues a task that calls dummyMock->mockMethod() without waiting.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Enqueues a task to unregister a client and waits for its completion.
